memoryBuilder.verseText: The people shouted: 'The Lord — He is God!'

sequence.prompt: What happened on the mountain? Put it in order.

items.label: Elijah poured water on the altar
Fire fell, and the people bowed down

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Elijah made it harder on purpose

application.question: The people wanted God and other things too. What do you sometimes love more than God?
application.followUp: Four hundred and fifty people shouted all day and got silence. One person prayed quietly and fire fell. God is not one choice out of many — He is the only real one, and He always hears. The Lord is God!
